memory-retrieval.label: Memory & retrieval

belief-updating.label: Belief updating
belief-updating.description: Patterns that shape how evidence, priors, repetition, and existing beliefs change what feels true.

probability-risk.label: Probability & risk
probability-risk.description: Patterns involving uncertainty, probability estimates, base rates, and perceived risk.

attention-information.label: Attention & information
attention-information.description: Patterns that affect what gets noticed, sampled, searched for, or omitted from consideration.

perception-patterns.label: Perception & patterns
perception-patterns.description: Patterns involving perceptual interpretation, agency detection, and seeing structure in ambiguous input.

valuation-choice.label: Valuation & choice
valuation-choice.description: Patterns involving framing, reference points, gains and losses, option comparison, and preference construction.

reasoning-flexibility.label: Reasoning & flexibility
reasoning-flexibility.description: Patterns involving logical errors, problem representation, rigidity, and fixation on familiar tools or solutions.

self-metacognition.label: Self & metacognition
self-metacognition.description: Patterns involving confidence, self-assessment, introspection, and beliefs about one's own thinking.

social-judgment.label: Social judgment
social-judgment.description: Patterns involving attribution, conformity, social inference, and judgments about other people.

time-commitment.label: Time & commitment
time-commitment.description: Patterns involving temporal preference, persistence, escalation, and commitment dynamics.
